newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins fluctuate, trend unclear.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins fluctuate, trend unclear.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds were little changed, fluctuating in calm trade on Tuesday amid mixed interests, including some banks taking profits after Monday's rise, dealers said.
"Russian banks were selling the fourth and fifth tranches in early trading for seemingly speculative aims, but foreign banks supported the market when they stepped in later," a dealer said.
Dealers said selling otherwise prevailed on the market as banks took profits after Monday's rise, which was initiated by an investment fund's purchase order.
"Prices are at morning levels now as Russian banks are mainly, but not actively, buying while the West is closing yesterday's long positions," another dealer said.
